verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents 'Rudder AI', an AI-powered agent in Slack that lets users manage/interact with their workspace, plus an MCP server enabling natural-language debugging, transformation testing, and Q&A over docs — both are delegation-style AI assistant capabilities built into the product ecosystem. However, these are more like task-specific copilot/chat interfaces via Slack or external MCP clients rather than a single built-in assistant embedded directly in the core product UI, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of real-world delegation use. missing for 10: hands-on/independent evidence of the assistant handling delegated tasks, clarity on native in-app (non-Slack/non-MCP-client) assistant UI, and broader task scope beyond debugging/transformations/Q&A.
